ACLE-001 tasks 4/5 remain false.
Assessment: The current effective store and mapping evidence is now available on this host. It does not attest a separate Windows store readback.
Required action / acceptance outcome: D0 must retain the exact effective mappings and task state it relies on, preserving pending managed obligations.

A01 PASS [medium]: Fresh host delta classification. Source: docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:72.
Evidence: D0 splits the fresh patch into hunks, maps every one or records an explained host difference, and blocks D4 on an unclassified or required-uncovered hunk. Missing-hunk and wrong-host negative controls are explicit.
Assessment: Different Windows context or content is preserved and dispositioned rather than assumed identical to Oct 4.
Required action / acceptance outcome: Bind the classification to each fresh preservation receipt.

A02 PASS [medium]: Entry evidence and explicit release. Source: docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:71.
Evidence: EntryEvidence_BindsBothHostsAndExplicitRelease requires installed commit/version per host, the completed Windows trace matrix, plan AGREE and the operator release before D0.
Assessment: Receipt arrival and review completion alone cannot release implementation.
Required action / acceptance outcome: Do not start D0 under the current DISAGREE verdict.

A03 PASS [medium]: Failure after restoration. Source: docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:76.
Evidence: D4 states that a D5 or later failure stops before E, keeps every original and receipt, reports per-host/path state and keeps restored source pinned. No automatic reapply/delete is allowed; first-host and both-host failure cases are named.
Assessment: The rollback contract preserves evidence without unapproved oracle mutation.
Required action / acceptance outcome: Keep this safe stopped state and request scoped authority for any recovery mutation.

N01 PASS [high]: R10 fixes the specific three-clock copy dependency. Source: docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:56.
Evidence: The supplied 190854-byte fixture has MAINCPU 1.2, clock 109163946 and PC 22377, DRIVE8 payload has_tde=0/has_drives=1. Pinned drive-cmdline-options.c lines 151-153 maps -drive8type to Drive8Type; drive-resources.c accepts NONE; drive-snapshot.c lines 540-550 skips all three clock copies when unit->type is NONE. D0/D1/D5 now own missing/TDE-off module scanning, required flags and fail-closed callers before native load.
Assessment: The original Phase D-before-Phase E clock-copy blocker has an operator-approved earlier disposition. This PASS is limited to those three copies; it does not prove the broader no-uninitialized-read assertion or unchanged peripheral context, evaluated in N03/N05.
Required action / acceptance outcome: Mock-prove computed flags for each unit, type NONE versus 1541 and absent/TDE-off modules, then retain the actual effective launch resource values on both hosts.

N02 FAIL [high]: Resume success and observable boundary remain underspecified. Source: docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:84.
Evidence: D5 chooses a discontinuity and a first PHI2 fetch but VICE_OBS exposes read/write/idle/dummy, not an opcode-fetch tag. mainc64cpu.c lines 359-362 permits stolen cycles before the load. The plan names a constrained positive case without stating its interrupt/BA/idle preconditions or first-read rule. R11 line 57 claims its MAINCPU read failure makes a later-module failure observable, yet c64-snapshot.c calls MAINCPU at 121 before CIA and other readers; a later failure follows a successful MAINCPU return and then resets at 146-153.
Assessment: A CPU-module resume record proves the loaded CPU fields, not successful complete snapshot restoration. The new predicates still lack a defined discriminator for the required idle/stolen/interrupt cases and a complete-load outcome. Reusing an earlier clock value also need not make an ordered marker ambiguous.
Required action / acceptance outcome: D1 must define the constrained fixture/state preconditions and observable record ordering; D5 must prove the same positive and negative cases on real traces, including idle/stolen first gates, pending interrupt, reused clock, unrelated reset and failure after MAINCPU succeeds. Define full-load success independently of a CPU-module success record; preserve complete AC1 resume/round-trip semantics.

A04 PASS [medium]: Pinned identity and Windows checkout bytes. Source: docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:76.
